title: Summoner match history
description: Enter a Riot ID to view recent supported matches and current ranked tiers.

search.label: Summoner search
search.invalid: Enter a complete Riot ID in the format game name#tag.
search.supported: Currently available for Korea and North America: Draft Pick, Swiftplay, Solo/Duo and Ranked Flex.

rank.snapshotDelta: This rank snapshot is about {{hours}} hours from the match time

refresh.complete: Match data is up to date.
refresh.partial: Update completed, but a few matches or participant ranks could not be fetched.
refresh.failed: Update failed. Please try again later.
refresh.notFound: That Riot ID was not found. Check the game name, tag and region.
refresh.notFoundInRegion: That Riot ID exists, but it has no summoner profile on {{region}}. Select the server where the account plays.
refresh.alreadyFresh: The cached data is already fresh.
refresh.rateLimited: Too many refresh requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
refresh.rateLimitedIdentity: That Riot ID was refreshed too recently. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
refresh.rateLimitedIP: This network started too many new lookups recently. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds; no task was created.
refresh.networkError: The backend could not be reached. Check that the service is still running and try again.
refresh.serviceUnavailable: The refresh service is unavailable. Check that the API, worker, and Temporal are running.
refresh.profileUnavailable: Riot did not return this account's summoner profile yet. Please try again shortly.
refresh.jobExpired: This update job is no longer available. Start a new refresh.
refresh.queuedStalled: The job is still queued. If it does not advance, check that the worker is running.
refresh.runningStalled: The job has not advanced recently. Cached matches remain available; check the worker logs.

state.error: Could not load match history. Please try again.
state.fetchingFirst: Fetching the latest 100 matches for this first lookup…
state.notFound: No cached data is available and the refresh did not complete.
